papers.title_en: CoRelate: Coordinated Human-Object Motion Synthesis through Interaction Relations
papers.authors: Zhiwen Qiu, Daisy Lin, Diyu Zhou, Jialin Wu, Rosita Ji, Saleh Kalantari
papers.evidence: 协调人-物运动合成的扩散框架
papers.tldr: 人-物运动合成需人在物体趋近目标时协调参与，但物体到达目标并不保证接触建立与保持，接触调整还可能干扰任务完成。CoRelate以显式交互关系和任务反馈驱动扩散生成，用“手-部件”关系指定参与手、部件相对参考位置与参与时段，并在去噪中联合修正人/物运动。实验在目标满足、接触F1与完整交互成功率上优于基线，消融验证关系条件及任务/关系反馈的互补作用。
papers.abstract_en: Human-object motion synthesis requires coordinated human participation as objects move toward specified goals. However, reaching object targets does not ensure that contact is established and maintained, while adjustments that improve contact may interfere with task completion. We introduce CoRelate, a diffusion framework that coordinates full-body human-object motion through explicit interaction relations and task feedback for rigid and articulated objects. We represent intended participation through hand-part relations that specify the participating hand, its part-relative reference position, and participation interval. These relations serve both as generation conditions and as references for measuring interaction realization. At each denoising step, a temporal refiner trained jointly with the generator combines relation deviations, task residuals, and motion features from the current prediction to jointly update human and object motion across the sequence. After generation, temporal motion correction addresses remaining contact failures by optimizing local motion segments while preserving object trajectories and protected human motion. Experiments demonstrate improved object-goal satisfaction, contact F1, and complete interaction success over the evaluated baselines. Ablation studies support the benefits of relation conditioning and the complementary roles of task and relation feedback.

papers.authors: Yi Wang, Yubo Zhao, Chi-Keung Tang
papers.evidence: 两阶段整流流用于文本驱动的3D人-物动作生成
papers.tldr: 文本驱动三维人-物交互生成需全身与物体运动在接触中耦合，但现有方法易把物体位姿、接触区域和肢体姿态与大量关节纠缠，或只规划末端/粗轨迹。CHORD用两阶段rectified-flow：Draft以每时间片12个部位token联合规划物体6-DoF轨迹、接触状态及各链末端/中间关节，并在流步中解码闭式干净估计、测量物体表面并将反馈零额外评估路由到责任token；Full保持计划并补齐其余身体与手指关节。InterAct上FID降33%，手接触F1由0.730升至0.834，反馈可迁移到未见物体并可即插即用。
papers.abstract_en: Text-driven 3D human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires synthesizing whole-body human and object motions that stay coupled through contact. Yet existing generators either entangle the core variables that govern an interaction (object pose, contacting regions, and limb posture) with dozens of subordinate joints, or plan only end-effectors or coarse trajectories. No stage of generation holds the interaction in a form that is both settled and observed, which leaves contact to external guidance, post-hoc refiners, or internal guidance without a surface measurement. We present CHORD, a two-stage rectified-flow framework that settles the interaction in a compact plan and observes that plan against the object surface while it is being generated. First, Draft uses twelve part tokens per temporal patch to jointly plan the 6-DoF object trajectory, contact states, and the end and middle joints of every kinematic chain. At each flow step, Draft decodes the expected interaction from the closed-form clean estimate, measures it against the object surface, and routes this feedback to the responsible part token with zero extra network evaluations. Second, Full keeps this plan unchanged and infills the remaining body and finger joints. On InterAct, CHORD reduces FID by 33% and lifts hand contact F1 from 0.730 to 0.834, while its feedback improves contact on unseen objects and transfers plug-and-play to existing HOI generators.

papers.title_en: Ego-HMB: Human Motion Bridging from Egocentric Images via A Motion Bridge Diffusion Model
papers.authors: Gaoge Han, Yongkang Cheng, Shaoli Huang, Jing Zhang, Mingming Gong, Fakhri Karray, Tongliang Liu
papers.evidence: 基于扩散的三维人体动作序列生成
papers.tldr: 从两张第一视角端点图像生成连贯3D人体运动是新任务，面临视角变化、身体部分可见与时序歧义。Ego-HMB用统一扩散框架，两阶段训练：先做自我中心到规范姿态的层次化预训练，再做融合端点与物理感知的运动桥扩散。实验在端点精度和运动生成质量上优于单阶段直接生成与两阶段估计加插值基线。该工作为VR/AR与机器人可穿戴场景提供端到端运动桥接方案。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Egocentric Human Motion Bridging, a task that generates a coherent 3D human motion sequence from two endpoint egocentric images. Unlike conventional motion in-betweening, which requires structured 3D endpoint poses, this setting uses raw first-person observations available from wearable devices in VR/AR and robotics. It presents challenges due to viewpoint variations, partial body visibility, and temporal ambiguity under cross-modal endpoint constraints. To address these challenges, we propose Ego-HMB, a unified diffusion-based framework that learns endpoint pose estimation and temporally consistent motion infilling within a single model through two training stages. First, Egocentric-to-Canonical Pretraining uses a hierarchical curriculum with progressively increasing temporal spans to strengthen endpoint pose priors. Second, Motion Bridge Diffusion Training incorporates endpoint and physics awareness, diffusing from neighboring poses to promote temporal continuity while preserving global endpoint constraints. Extensive experiments compare our approach with one-stage methods that directly generate motion from two egocentric images and two-stage pipelines that combine endpoint pose estimation with motion interpolation. Ego-HMB consistently outperforms these baselines in endpoint accuracy and motion generation quality. Code is available at https://github.com/gaogehan/Ego-HMB.

papers.title_en: Motion Mamba 2.0: Autoregressive Diffusion Mamba for Long-Horizon Humanoid Control
papers.authors: Yue Huang, Tianshan Zhang, Zeyu Zhang, Jayeon Kang, Akide Liu, Sungjoon Choi, Dacheng Tao, Hao Tang
papers.evidence: 基于扩散的长时程可控人体动作生成
papers.tldr: 长时程实时可控人体动作生成需响应变化指令与空间目标，但现有自回归扩散方法受限于有界注意力缓存与重复去噪的高开销。Motion Mamba 2.0 提出基于 Mamba 的根-身体扩散架构，融合局部注意力、可恢复循环状态与持久内容记忆 PCM。在重定向 HiPHI 上实现 39.52 秒终态精确控制，RTX 4090 上中位延迟由 1685.35 ms 降至 276.14 ms，约 6.138 倍加速且输出一致。并在 Unitree G1 上验证文本引导动作组合与交互式控制。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon, real-time controllable motion generation is essential for interactive animation and humanoid robotics, where an agent must respond to changing instructions and spatial goals while moving. Existing autoregressive diffusion methods generate motion incrementally, but bounded attention caches limit access to distant history, while repeated denoising introduces substantial inference overhead. We present Motion Mamba 2.0, a Mamba-based root-body diffusion architecture that integrates local attention, resumable recurrent states, and persistent content memory (PCM) for long-horizon controllable motion generation. PCM transforms compressed motion history from Mamba recurrent states, together with state changes and text-conditioned features, into dynamically updated content slots accessible to local attention. To enable efficient inference, we further develop an execution scheme tailored to this architecture, combining CUDA Graph replay, fused kernels, and execution-flow simplification while preserving the canonical history update. Evaluations on retargeted HiPHI demonstrate accurate terminal control over rollouts of up to 39.52 s, while short-horizon comparisons on BONES Seed and retargeted HumanML3D show that the model also retains strong spatial control and text-motion matching. On an RTX 4090, the optimized execution reduces median complete-window latency from 1685.35 to 276.14 ms, achieving a median paired speedup of 6.138$\times$ while preserving identical outputs and committed states in the tested rollouts. Moreover, we conduct extensive real-world evaluation on the Unitree G1, demonstrating sequential text-guided action composition, expressive motion, and interactive locomotion through keyboard and mouse control.

papers.title_en: DuoFlow: Towards Synchronized Speech and Motion Generation with Fine-Grained Control
papers.authors: Jun Dong, Ronghui Li, Zhongyuan Hu, Yunqi Zhao, Lijie Guo, Ruizhang Xu, Di Kang, Linchao Bao, Xiu Li
papers.evidence: 双流潜在流Transformer联合语音与动作生成
papers.tldr: 现有联合语音-动作生成多依赖文本语义或中间语音表征，缺少对动作层级、身体部位与声音风格的显式控制。为此，作者构建带转写、声音风格描述和两级动作条件的MotionSpeech基准，并提出双流潜空间流变换器DuoFlow。该方法在共享噪声水平和统一秒级时间坐标下联合去噪语音与动作，以模态残差连接器注入条件、层间双向跨模态注意力协调生成，并用单调音素通路结合CTC监督强化语音时序。实验表明其可生成高质量、同步且符合指令的语音-动作序列，并提供细粒度动作与声音风格统一控制接口。
papers.abstract_en: An embodied speaker's expressiveness depends not only on what is said, but also on how the voice sounds and how the body moves. However, existing joint speech-motion generation models are largely driven implicitly by transcript semantics or intermediate speech representations, offering little explicit control over motion hierarchy, body parts, or vocal style. To bridge this gap, we construct MotionSpeech, a structured benchmark for controllable joint speech-motion generation that includes transcripts, voice-style descriptions, and motion conditions at two hierarchical levels. Building on this benchmark, we propose DuoFlow, a dual-stream latent flow transformer that jointly denoises speech and motion under a shared noise level and a unified second-based temporal coordinate. Modality-specific residual connectors inject structured conditions into the corresponding streams, layer-wise bidirectional cross-modal attention coordinates their generation, and a monotonic phoneme pathway combines normalized progress anchors with CTC supervision to strengthen speech temporal modeling. DuoFlow provides a unified interface for fine-grained motion and vocal-style control and demonstrates the ability to synthesize high-quality, synchronized, and instruction-consistent speech-motion sequences. Project page, https://jundong-dev.github.io/DuoFlow-project-page.

papers.title_en: PIAE: Physics-Informed Continuous Autoencoding for Compact 3D Human Motion
papers.authors: Osama Alshammari, Omar Mohammed, Kerven Durdymyradov, Naeemullah Khan
papers.evidence: 面向动作生成器的紧凑三维人体动作编码
papers.tldr: 时序压缩能缩短动作生成序列，却易损伤关节细节与全局轨迹，且根速度和朝向误差会放大到全身。PIAE用物理信息连续自编码器在固定token预算中显式保留运动学信号并学习互补特征，8倍压缩下每个256维token含224维学习值与32维物理载体。在HumanML3D上取得8.936毫米全局MPJPE，较同宽纯学习模型降低82.0%，并提升下游生成FID与重建质量。
papers.abstract_en: Temporal compression reduces the sequence length that motion generators must model, but can damage articulated detail and global trajectory. These errors have unequal consequences: root-velocity and heading errors propagate through trajectory recovery and affect the placement of the entire body. We propose PIAE, a physics-informed continuous autoencoder that allocates a fixed token budget between explicitly retained kinematic signals and complementary learned features. At 8 x temporal compression, each 256-dimensional token contains 224 learned values and a 32-dimensional physical carrier. The complete token conditions neural decoding, while a parallel recovery path constrains selected outputs. On the official HumanML3D benchmark, PIAE achieves 8.936 mm global MPJPE, an 82.0% reduction relative to a same-width learned-only model. The benefit extends beyond trajectory restoration: facing-local neural-body error before analytical correction decreases by 76.6% in a frozen-checkpoint validation diagnostic, and supplying the same true trajectory to both models preserves the body-quality advantage. Targeted root-only and explicit-root hybrid controls establish strong trajectory-aware comparisons; alternative carriers reveal that torso references favor position accuracy, whereas stance anchors favor support quality. With the original 8 x AEs frozen, matched text-to-motion generators predict every carrier value and improve FID from 0.506 to 0.163. Frozen reconstruction also transfers to AIST++ without adaptation. The compressed carrier interface reduces measured generation time by 27.8% relative to its 1 x counterpart. Together, these findings demonstrate that selective preservation can use a fixed representation budget more effectively, improving neural articulated reconstruction and downstream generation in compact human motion.

papers.title_en: MetricHand: Geometry-Aware Flow Matching for 4D Hand Reconstruction in Metric World Space
papers.authors: Yibo Bai, Likui Zhang, Jinglei Zhang, Zhengbin Pang, Xingshen Song, Xiaoqing Yin, Jinsheng Deng
papers.evidence: 面向4D手部人体运动的几何感知流匹配
papers.tldr: 第一人称手部运动需准确且时序连贯的度量世界空间4D重建，但现有方法把弱透视逐帧估计提升到世界坐标，忽略近距离关节深度变化，使平移、朝向与关节误差耦合。MetricHand提出几何感知流匹配，将手物交互深度先验编码为关节关联表示，与视觉特征融合来约束度量估计和时序生成。模型联合恢复世界平移、全局朝向、MANO关节与形状。相较HaWoR，相机空间MPJPE降低49.3%和52.9%，世界空间MPJPE降低28.7%和21.7%，表明绝对定位与时序精度提升。
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric hand motion provides physical motion supervision for dexterous manipulation and vision-language-action pretraining. Reliable use of this supervision requires accurate and temporally coherent 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. Existing methods typically lift framewise estimates produced under weak perspective into world coordinates. By ignoring joint-dependent depth variation at close range, this approximation couples errors in translation, orientation, and articulation that persist after world lifting and worsen under occlusion. We present MetricHand, a geometry-aware flow matching framework for 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. MetricHand encodes depth priors from hand-object interaction regions into joint-associated representations that preserve local spatial structure and metric scale. Fused with visual features, this geometry guides coarse metric estimation and conditions every step of temporal generation. The model jointly recovers world-space translation, global orientation, MANO articulation, and shape, while structural priors and temporal context support estimation under partial occlusion. MetricHand reduces camera-space MPJPE by 49.3% and 52.9%, absolute world-space MPJPE by 28.7% and 21.7%, and wrist localization error by 48.5% and 37.9% relative to HaWoR, respectively. World-space acceleration error decreases by 44.2% and 64.3%, demonstrating improved temporal fidelity alongside more accurate absolute localization.

papers.title_en: Tri-DNO: Trilateral Diffusion Noise Optimization for 3D Human Object Interaction
papers.authors: Paul Hinzer, Niklas Gard, Anna Hilsmann, Peter Eisert
papers.evidence: 用于三维人-物交互生成的扩散噪声优化
papers.tldr: 针对3D人-物交互生成中手部抓握易出现接触不足或穿透的问题，Tri-DNO提出一种扩散噪声优化策略。该方法不修改或重训预训练多模态HOI扩散模型，而是迭代优化生成器的初始噪声，以增强手物接触并抑制穿透。在GRAB数据集上，其抓握质量优于基线，且无需额外训练或增加计算成本。该工作为高质量HOI合成与媒体制作提供了实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Generating realistic 3D human object interactions (HOI) is essential for applications, such as augmented or virtual reality (AR/VR) or character animation of interactive entertainment. A particular challenge lies in the faithful generation of hand grasps in human object interaction scenes, where even minor geometric inconsistencies, such as insufficient contact or interpenetration, can significantly compromise realism. While diffusion-based generative models have shown promising results in HOI synthesis, ensuring physically plausible hand-object interactions remains challenging.   We present Tri-DNO, a diffusion noise optimization strategy to sample from a pretrained multimodal HOI diffusion model, improving hand-object contact. Rather than modifying or retraining the generative model, our approach iteratively optimizes the initial noise of the diffusion generator, thereby generating firm hand object contact, while mitigating penetration and keeping the hand position realistic. Experiments on the GRAB dataset demonstrate improvements over the baseline in grasp quality without additional model training or increased computational cost compared to existing methods. We further demonstrate the applicability of our approach to practical media production scenarios.
